title: Keep the strong special-source theorem separate from the weak CTMC endpoint
statement: On the specified four-state discrete source,one6000-step stationary trace reportedly recovers75–100%of realised path entropy with probability>=97.5%,selection penalties included;saved synthetic draw recovered90.0%. The source-family sequential implementation increases precision as tuning decreases. This is not general-source finite power. A SEPARATE CTMC binary-record control certifies395.8nats,only a small fraction of that simulated trajectory entropy;duration,preparation and latent jumps are paid. Earlier88-versus89-transition martingale control shows little advantage;the final generic compiler still loses to a simpler statistic on its stated fixture. Solo controls and proofs are reported,not Capital replay or physical evidence.
